# Cursor BYOK v1.0.2

## 更新内容

- 适配 Cursor 3.29 协议（二进制 `BidiAppend`、Agent mode configs、推理参数与结构化错误保留、上下文窗口与用量环恢复、`RunInference` reasoning effort 继承）。
- 新增公开模型价格同步、单次调用费用持久化与历史回填，支持按默认人民币汇率（6.8）或自定义汇率切换 USD/CNY 展示，并统一生成速度与耗时指标。
- 优化桌面端概览页签、供应商筛选、贡献日历摘要面板、宽屏布局与响应缩放，新增首页自动刷新、调用记录更新绿色高亮及界面偏好 SQLite 持久化。
- 将发布流水线、仓库地址与客户端自动更新端点切换至本 Windows-only 分支仓库 `Judgecut/cursor-byok`。

## Changes

- Adapt Cursor 3.29 protocol changes (binary `BidiAppend` payloads, agent mode configs, model parameter and structured inference error preservation, context ring usage and window limits, and `RunInference` reasoning effort inheritance).
- Add public model pricing catalog sync, per-call cost persistence and backfill, USD/CNY currency display (with a default CNY rate of 6.8), and unified generation speed and timing metrics.
- Improve overview tabs, supplier filters, contribution calendar summary panel, full-width responsive layout, home auto-refresh, green update highlight on call rows, and SQLite persistence for interface preferences.
- Switch release workflows, repository links, and Windows auto-update endpoints to this Windows-only fork (`Judgecut/cursor-byok`).

## 注意事项 / Notes

- 本分支当前仅构建与测试 Windows x64（NSIS 安装包与便携版 ZIP）。This fork currently targets and tests Windows x64 only (NSIS installer and portable ZIP).
- 安装包仅包含应用内更新签名，未做 Windows Authenticode 代码签名。The installer uses Tauri updater signatures only and is not Authenticode-signed.
